examples.sentence: 出现非正常情况时请不要紧张。
examples.romanization: chūxiàn fēizhèngcháng qíngkuàng shí qǐng bùyào jǐnzhāng。
examples.translation: Please do not be nervous when emergencies (lit. abnormal conditions) occur.

examples.sentence: 成功有时候并非想象中那么难。
examples.romanization: chénggōng yǒushíhou bìngfēi xiǎngxiàng zhōng nàme nán。
examples.translation: Success is sometimes not as difficult as it might seem.

examples.sentence: 对小王来说，今天是一个不平常的日子。
examples.romanization: duì xiǎo wáng láishuō， jīntiān shì yī gè bùpíngcháng de rìzi。
examples.translation: For Xiao Wang, today is an extraordinary day.

examples.sentence: 他平常总是来得很早，今天却迟到了。
examples.romanization: tā píngcháng zǒngshì lái dehěn zǎo， jīntiān què chí dàoliǎo。
examples.translation: He usually comes very early, but he is late today.

examples.sentence: 作为母亲，她宁可自已累一点儿，也不想委屈了孩子。
examples.romanization: zuòwéi mǔqīn， tā nìngkě zì yǐ lèi yīdiǎnr， yě bùxiǎng wěiqu le háizi。
examples.translation: As a mother, she would rather be tired of herself and would not want to wrong her child.

examples.sentence: 怎么只有你们两个人？其余的同学呢？
examples.romanization: zěnme zhǐyǒu nǐmen liǎng gèrén？ qíyú de tóngxué ne？
examples.translation: How come you two people? What about the rest of the classmates?

title: (由此) 可见 (This shows that)
longExplanation: This shows that. Pinyin: ( yóucǐ) kějiàn

examples.sentence: 由此可见，成功是需要努力的。
examples.romanization: yóucǐkějiàn， chénggōng shì xūyào nǔlì de。
examples.translation: This shows that success requires hard work.

examples.sentence: 她的脸上露出了阳光般的笑容。
examples.romanization: tā de liǎn shàng lùchū le yángguāng bān de xiàoróng。
examples.translation: Her face showed a sunny (lit. like sunlight) smile.

examples.sentence: 他把壶盖儿打开，闻了闻，原来是酒。
examples.romanization: tā bǎ hú gàir dǎkāi， wén le wén， yuánlái shì jiǔ。
examples.translation: He opened the lid of the pot and smelled it. It turned out to be alcohol.
Seeing is believing. (Lit. hearing about something 100 times is not as good as seeing it once.)

examples.sentence: 趁电影还没开始，我去买两瓶矿泉水。
examples.romanization: chèn diànyǐng hái méi kāishǐ， wǒ qù mǎi liǎng píng kuàngquánshuǐ。
examples.translation: The movie hasn’t started, I’ll make use of the opportunity and get two bottles of mineral water.

examples.sentence: 他家里很穷，买不起灯，一到晚上就不能读书。
examples.romanization: tā jiālǐ hěn qióng， mǎibuqǐ dēng， yī dào wǎnshang jiù bùnéng dúshū。
examples.translation: His family is very poor and can't afford a lamp, [so he] can’t read at night.

title: V 得起 (can stand/tolerate)
longExplanation: can stand/tolerate. Pinyin: V dé qǐ

examples.sentence: 经得起时间考验的朋友才算是真正的朋友。
examples.romanization: jīngdeqǐ shíjiān kǎoyàn de péngyou cái suànshì zhēnzhèng de péngyou。
examples.translation: A friend who can stand the test of time is a true friend.
